requirements.summary: Controller identity comes from server Task/session, not actor arguments. Per-app background AX plus per-controller virtual selection; cancellable per-app/system-device/capture FIFO. Native virtual pointer display never captures input. Fix mismatched image budget (#834) and preserve desktop geometry; visual review covers clear canvas controls.
